claims.summary: Neutral blind cases can enter a distinct single-model Codex training-review workflow without becoming human or independent evidence.
An accepted preference requires two fresh reversed-order Codex sessions, scoring before preference, stable unblinding, five dimension floors, a positive margin, and concrete defects.
The corpus path binds packet, source, judge, artifacts, scorecards, passes, and exact training-pair bytes and rejects tampering, omission, identity drift, session reuse, and position disagreement.
Dataset schema v3 and adapter gates require balanced single-model-judge evidence for research and candidate learned-quality claims while keeping optional instructor counts separate.
